description: Implementation of rx::VertexArray11 class for Direct3D 11 rendering in ANGLE, managing vertex array state, synchronization, and index/attribute updates.

classes.name: VertexArray11
classes.description: Manages vertex array state, synchronization, and index/attribute updates for ANGLE's Direct3D 11 backend.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes vertex array state based on dirty bits, updating attributes and buffers as needed.

methods.name: syncStateForDraw
methods.description: Prepares vertex array state for drawing, updating index and attribute data based on draw parameters.

methods.name: updateElementArrayStorage
methods.description: Updates the storage type for element array indices based on current indices and buffer state.

methods.name: updateVertexAttribStorage
methods.description: Determines and updates the storage type for a specific vertex attribute.

methods.name: hasActiveDynamicAttrib
methods.description: Checks if there are active dynamic attributes for the current program.

methods.name: updateDirtyAttribs
methods.description: Updates attributes marked as dirty, translating static or direct attributes as needed.

methods.name: updateDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Updates dynamic attributes for a range of vertices during drawing.

methods.name: getTranslatedAttribs
methods.description: Returns the list of translated attributes.

methods.name: markAllAttributeDivisorsForAdjustment
methods.description: Adjusts attribute divisors based on the number of views.

methods.name: getCachedIndexInfo
methods.description: Returns cached index data if valid.

methods.name: isCachedIndexInfoValid
methods.description: Checks if cached index info is valid.

methods.name: getCachedDestinationIndexType
methods.description: Returns the cached destination index type.
